name: (01) Thaumaturgy (The Green Path) — 1 Basic — Herbal Wisdom

system.description:
At a touch, the thaumaturge rouses the spirit of a plant to speech; an ancient tree may offer cryptic wisdom while ordinary crabgrass reveals only the face of the last to tread upon it.

Touch the plant you wish to question and activate the power. You may ask a single question and receive an answer that, though it may not be helpful, is always true. To draw out more detail, make a Static Mental Challenge against the Storyteller; on a win the spirit divulges whatever fuller information it can. Retest with Occult.
